# Semyon Morgunov / Семён Моргунов

> Director of E-commerce at Korzinka — Uzbekistan's largest grocery retailer and e-grocery service. 8 years in tech, 5 in product management, 3 in e-commerce. Co-founder of 4 ventures. Based in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. Advises startups and angel-invests in e-com, FoodTech, RetailTech, FinTech, and EdTech.

## About

- Name: Semyon Morgunov (Семён Моргунов)
- Current role: Director of E-commerce @ Korzinka, Tashkent, Uzbekistan
- Past roles: Head of Product @ Yandex Services (2022–2023); Head of Growth & Monetization @ Skyeng/Skysmart (2017–2022); Certified Sales Trainer @ Apple Russia (2018–2019, contractor)
- Skills: Product Management, Growth, Monetization, 0→1 Launches
- Industries: e-com, FoodTech, RetailTech, FinTech, EdTech
- Teaching: I-Corps instructor; one of five Apple-accredited sales trainers in Russia at the time
- Languages: Russian (primary), English

## Products

- [Fingerprint](https://fprint.morgunov.tech/) — web service that reveals your browser's digital fingerprint and gives actionable privacy recommendations; runs locally in the browser
- [FoundYou](https://foundyou.morgunov.tech/) — web tool that reveals photo metadata (geolocation, time, device) and removes sensitive info; blurs faces, plates, documents; processes photos locally
- [Telegram channel «Semyon raspravil plechi» / «Семён расправил плечи»](https://t.me/raschet7) — personal channel on technology, products, management, and career; 1100+ subscribers; new posts every 1–2 weeks
